13.3 Atoms: Their Types and Weights

13.3.3 Logical Links

There is a host of link types embodying logical relationships as defined in the PLN logic system,

e.g.

e InheritanceLink e SubsetLink (aka ExtensionalInheritanceLink) e Intensional InheritanceLink

which embody different sorts of inheritance, e.g.

SubsetLink salmon fish IntensionalInheritanceLink whale fish InheritanceLink fish animal

and then

e SimilarityLink e ExtensionalSimilarityLink e IntensionalSimilarityLink

which are symmetrical versions, e.g.

SimilaritytLink shark barracuda IntensionalSimilarityLink shark dolphin ExtensionalSimiliarityLink American obese\_person

There are also higher-order versions of these links, both asymmetric

e ImplicationLink e ExtensionallmplicationLink e IntensionallmplicationLink

and symmetric

e EquivalenceLink e ExtensionalEquivalenceLink e IntensionalEquivalenceLink

These are used between predicates and links, e.g.

ImplicationLink EvaluationLink eat ListLink $X aan, EvaluationLink feel ListLink $X sick
